name: Kasshoku Shimai de Ikou! -Minea to Manya no Monogatari-
original_name: 褐色姉妹でイこう! -ミネアとマーニャの物語-
source: A fan fiction nukige of the two twins from Dragon Quest IV, Minea and Manya. Sold into slavery and forced to prostitution they struggle to buy themselves free.
translation: 一部以《勇者斗恶龙IV》姐妹米妮娅和玛妮娅为主角的同人拔作。两人被卖为奴隶，又被迫卖淫，只能挣扎着攒钱赎回自由。
